description: Generate multiple pixel art sprites in a single batch. Items are generated together on a grid for visual consistency, then split into individual PNGs. Ideal for item sets, inventory icons, collectibles, or any group of related sprites.

background.description: Background color for generation. Use "auto" to pick based on items. (default: black)

items.description: List of item descriptions (max 16). E.g. ["red apple", "banana", "cherry", "grapes"]

model.description: Model alias or full ID. Aliases: 25, nano-banana, banana, banana-2, nano-banana-2, gemini-flash, flash, gemini-pro, pro, gemini-25, gemini-flash-25 (default: nano-banana)

names.description: Custom file names for each item (default: item-0, item-1, ...)

outputPrefix.description: Output path prefix — items saved as {prefix}-{name}.png (e.g. "public/assets/items/fruit")

references.description: Paths to existing PNG/JPEG assets to match visual style.

size.description: Target sprite size in pixels (default: 48). Snaps to nearest standard size.

square.description: Pad each item to square (default: true)

name: forge_item_kit
